summary_en: Dividend prediction revised for FY9/26: final dividend ¥25/share (ordinary ¥15 + 80th anniversary special ¥10), interim ¥30/share, annual run-rate ¥80/share on pre-split basis. Maintains cumulative dividend policy of payout ratio ≥30% through SANYO VISION 2028 period.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Prediction Revision (80th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Sanyo Trading has revised its FY9/26 (ending September 2026) dividend prediction to include an 80th anniversary commemorative dividend. The company announced on 2 August 2026 that its final dividend will be ¥25 per share, comprising an ordinary dividend of ¥15 and a special commemorative dividend of ¥10, in addition to the interim dividend of ¥30 per share already paid. On a pre-stock-split basis, the full-year dividend run-rate totals ¥80 per share. The company executed a 2-for-1 stock split effective 1 July 2026; the disclosed amounts reflect post-split per-share figures for the final dividend but historical comparators are stated on pre-split basis. The company reaffirmed that it will continue its stated dividend policy of a payout ratio of 30% or above and progressive dividends during the SANYO VISION 2028 planning period, with the 80th anniversary dividend treated as a separate, one-time addition to that baseline commitment.
